name: stiffness
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 构件或连接抵抗变形的力学特性。

complete_examples.text: The failure of rail fastener is simulated by setting the stiffness and damping of rail fasteners to be zeroes in the compiled vehicle-track coupled model.
So it is rather important to choose the rail lateral stiffness reasonably.
The vertical stiffness and damping of intact fasteners in this line are set to 5e7 N/m and 5e4 N·s/m, respectively.
Fastener damages are simulated by setting five stiffness coefficients (i.e. 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2) and five damping coefficients (i.e. 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and 1).
